thread:
sam: Hey team — customer hitting 400 on /v1/rerank. Body shows 'items' but payload mixes strings and objects. Example they sent:
```
POST /v1/rerank
{ "items": ["candidate1", {"id": 2, "text": "c2"}], "queries": [{"id": "q1", "text": "Find best"}], "top_k": "5" }
```
Response: 400 Bad Request {"error":"invalid_items_type","detail":"items must be array of objects with id+text"}

priya: Do we have a quick repro? Is this SDK or curl? Any headers like Content-Type missing?

sam: Customer said node SDK v2.3. They constructed a mixed array accidentally (they map over list of ids in one path). Content-Type: application/json included. Repro with curl below.

sam: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/rerank \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"items":["123","456",{"id":"789","text":"ok"}],"queries":[{"id":"q1","text":"Which is best?"}],"top_k":"3"}'
```

eli: I suspect two issues: 1) items can be objects only; string ids only supported under 'indices' in older API. 2) top_k should be integer, string causes schema failure. We should return clearer error. Can we confirm server error key? logs?

sam: Logs show schema validation failed at items[0] type != object, and top_k not integer. Customer expects us to coerce string->int and allow string ids, but current API doesn't.

priya: Reply to customer: confirm expected shapes and example valid payload. Offer quick patch or client-side fix. Also ask for full raw request body for audit. I'll draft.

sam: Drafted message: "Thanks — the rerank API expects items to be array of objects: [{id: string, text: string}]. top_k must be integer. Please resend JSON. Example: {"items":[{"id":"1","text":"candidate one"}],"queries":[{"id":"q1","text":"Which is best?"}],"top_k":3}"

qa-bot: Repro test added to support/fixtures: rerank_mixed_items_topk_string.json — failing case captured. :white_check_mark:

eli: Also log ticket for SDK change to validate earlier. #ENG-4521

priya: Sending to customer now. :thumbsup:
